title: Your Bills: Zoom Out
briefing: 0–3 doctored today. Some numbers hit different when you zoom out.

posts.body: The average Rockland customer using about 650 kilowatt-hours within a billing cycle can expect their bill to decrease by $67, board staff said, and ratepayers with Atlantic City Electric will pay 5 cents less each month.
NJ residential electricity prices surged 24% in one year — from 19.9¢ to 24.65¢ per kWh.

I don't know if everyone in New Jersey understands, but it is the most expensive hours of the year that are driving the really unsustainable price hikes in the utility and electricity bills that we saw in the last few years

posts.body: NJ utilities board votes to keep electricity rates level
…New Jersey electricity bills jumped roughly 20 percent last year, driven in large part by rising costs in PJM's capacity market.
